title: Scored a perfect 10 on a product quality review
summary: I assessed software and cybersecurity for a product quality review and brought new ideas to it; the stakeholder gave an NPS of 10 and the program leader called it a bull's eye.
what_would_have_happened: The product team would get findings without detailed software and cybersecurity comments on each question.
the_call: Bring new ideas to the review and answer every question in detail.
what_i_did: Reviewed all 30 software and cybersecurity questions, answered the team's open questions and asked for their review.
what_changed: The stakeholder scored the work an NPS of 10; my manager and the program leader praised it.
